repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是基于 MCP 协议的逆向工程智能体框架，支持原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集及网页的多平台分析。通过对接 Hopper、Ghidra、IDA 等专业工具，让 AI 智能体在本地完成代码审查与行为逆向，输出带证据链的结论，适用于竞品分析与安全研究。
repos.summary_en: REA is an MCP-based reverse engineering agent framework supporting multi-platform analysis of native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. It connects to Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA for local code inspection and behavioral reverse engineering with evidence-backed conclusions, ideal for competitive analysis and security research.

repos.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repos.summary_zh: 微软开源Python工具，将Office文档、PDF、音视频等30+格式转换为Markdown。专为LLM和文本分析管道设计，保留标题、列表、表格等结构，输出token高效。集成OCR、语音转录、YouTube下载等能力，提供MCP服务器供Claude等LLM应用调用。流式处理无临时文件，插件化架构支持扩展。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's open-source Python utility converts 30+ file formats (Office documents, PDF, images, audio, HTML, etc.) to Markdown for LLM and text analysis pipelines. Preserves document structure—headings, lists, tables, links—with token-efficient output. Integrates OCR, speech transcription, YouTube processing, and MCP server for Claude/LLM integration. Stream-based processing eliminates temporary files; plugin architecture enables custom converters.

repos.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
repos.summary_zh: Scrapling 是一个自适应网页抓取框架，能够处理从单请求到大规模爬取的全场景需求。其核心亮点在于智能解析器可学习网站变化并自动重定位元素，内置绕过 Cloudflare 等反爬系统的能力，支持并发多会话爬取、自动代理轮换和暂停恢复功能。提供实时统计、CLI 和 MCP 服务器集成，是现代 Web 数据采集的高效解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Scrapling is an adaptive web scraping framework designed to handle everything from simple single requests to complex large-scale crawling operations. Its standout feature is an intelligent parser that learns from website changes and automatically relocates elements when pages update. The framework includes built-in anti-bot bypass capabilities that defeat systems like Cloudflare Turnstile out of the box. It enables concurrent multi-session crawling with automatic proxy rotation, pause/resume functionality, and real-time streaming statistics. With integrated CLI tools and an MCP server, Scrapling offers a powerful yet straightforward solution for modern web data extraction at any scale.

repos.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Headroom 是 AI 智能体的上下文压缩层，能压缩工具输出、日志、RAG 块和文件，减少 60-95% 令牌并保持答案质量。提供 Python/TS 库、代理和 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude、Cursor 等集成。具备可逆 CCR 压缩、跨代理内存共享和失败学习等功能，支持 6 种算法，本地优先，显著提升 LLM 交互效率。
repos.summary_en: Headroom acts as the context optimization layer for LLM applications and AI agents. It compresses tool outputs, logs, RAG chunks, files, DB results, and more before they reach the model, achieving 60-95% token reduction while preserving 100% answer accuracy. Deployable as a Python or TypeScript library, transparent proxy, MCP server, or integrations with LangChain, Agno, Vercel AI SDK, and 100+ LLM providers. Key highlights include reversible CCR compression, smart content detection across formats, persistent hierarchical memory, failure learning that updates agent docs, image compression via ML, cache optimization, and six specialized algorithms. Local-first and multi-agent compatible, it drastically cuts costs and latency for LLM interactions.

repos.description: Learn AI Engineering! Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.summary_zh: 《AI工程从零开始》是开源AI工程课程，含473课、20阶段、约320小时。从数学基础到多智能体系统与生产，覆盖Python等多语言。核心是每算法从原始数学手工构建，再用框架对比，每课产出提示、技能、代理或MCP服务器等可复用产物。填补工具使用与专业准备差距，帮助深入掌握AI internals，免费MIT许可，配网站与技能集成，适合开发者实战学习与构建系统。
repos.summary_en: AI Engineering from Scratch is a comprehensive open-source curriculum with 473 lessons across 20 phases (~320 hours). It spans math foundations to deep learning, transformers, LLMs built from scratch, agent engineering, multi-agent swarms, production, and ethics. Learners implement algorithms from raw math in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia before frameworks. Every lesson ships reusable artifacts: prompts, skills, agents, MCP servers. Emphasizes deep understanding over API calls. Free MIT license with website and agent skills for personalized paths.

repos.description: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.
repos.summary_zh: Cherry Studio 是一款 AI 生产力桌面应用，集成智能聊天与自主代理能力，内置 300+ 专业助手。通过统一接口无缝接入 GPT-4、Claude 等前沿大模型，支持多语言交互与上下文感知，覆盖文档处理、代码生成、研究分析等场景，实现智能化升级并显著提升工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Cherry Studio is a comprehensive AI productivity desktop application that seamlessly integrates intelligent chat interfaces with autonomous agent capabilities, featuring over 300 specialized assistants for various domains. The platform provides unified access to leading large language models including GPT-4 and Claude, supports multilingual interactions with advanced context awareness, enables intelligent automation across document processing, code generation, and research analysis scenarios, and offers a user-friendly interface for both technical and non-technical users, significantly enhancing workplace productivity and operational efficiency through streamlined workflows.

repos.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是 HKUDS 开发的开源超轻量级 AI 智能体，核心设计精简且可读。它支持聊天通道、记忆管理和 MCP 协议，可无缝集成工具与工作流。内置 WebUI，提供跨轮次目标追踪和图像生成能力，支持多模型 fallback。从本地快速部署到长期运行的个性化智能体，适用于自动化任务和智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an open-source, ultra-lightweight AI agent developed by HKUDS, featuring a minimalist and readable core design. It supports chat channels, memory management, and the MCP protocol for seamless tool and workflow integration. With a built-in WebUI, it offers cross-turn goal tracking and end-to-end image generation, along with multi-model fallback support. Designed for easy deployment from local setups to long-running personal agents, it is ideal for automation tasks and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: 3,000+ reusable AI agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. AAS Core adds local catalog discovery, agent-owned selection and plan preview. CLI, MCP and plugins.
repos.summary_zh: Agentic Awesome Skills 是一个可安装的 GitHub 库，汇集 1936+ 个 agentic skills，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手设计。提供 SKILL.md 结构化剧本、插件、捆绑包和工作流，支持编码、调试、测试、安全审查等任务。通过 npm 安装器实现多工具兼容，强化提示工程应用，提升 AI 代理上下文与输出质量，是社区驱动的 AI 开发自动化核心资源。
repos.summary_en: Agentic Awesome Skills is an installable GitHub library with 1,936+ reusable agentic skills for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It delivers structured SKILL.md playbooks, plugins, bundles, and workflows for coding, debugging, testing, and security tasks. Featuring an npm installer and multi-tool compatibility, it strengthens prompt engineering to improve AI agent context and outputs, serving as a community hub for AI-assisted development automation.

repos.description: GitNexus: The Zero-Server Code Intelligence Engine
repos.summary_zh: GitNexus 是一个零服务器、纯客户端的代码智能引擎，可在浏览器中构建代码知识图谱。它通过分析代码库中的依赖关系、调用链和执行流，为 AI 代理提供深度架构视图，解决代码遗漏和依赖断裂问题。支持 CLI+MCP 模式连接 Cursor、Claude Code 等编辑器，也提供 Web UI 进行可视化探索。采用 KuzuDB 和 Tree-sitter 技术，内置 Graph RAG 智能体，让中小型模型也能获得大模型的架构理解能力，适用于代码审查、架构分析和 AI 辅助开发场景。
repos.summary_en: GitNexus is a zero-server, client-side code intelligence engine that builds knowledge graphs directly in the browser. It analyzes dependencies, call chains, and execution flows to provide AI agents with deep architectural visibility, preventing missed code and broken dependencies. The CLI+MCP mode integrates with editors like Cursor and Claude Code for daily development, while the Web UI enables visual exploration. Built on KuzuDB and Tree-sitter, it features a Graph RAG Agent that gives smaller models architectural clarity comparable to large models, ideal for code review and AI-assisted development.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提示词工程优化的 AI 应用工具，支持多模型集成与 MCP 协议。通过智能优化、对比测试和高级调试模式，显著提升 LLM 输出质量与稳定性。提供 Web、桌面、Chrome 插件及 Docker 多端部署，采用纯前端架构确保数据安全，适用于角色扮演、知识提取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is a powerful AI application tool dedicated to prompt engineering optimization, supporting multi-model integration and MCP protocol compatibility. It significantly improves LLM output quality and stability through intelligent prompt refinement, real-time A/B testing, and advanced debugging features including context variables and function calling. The tool offers versatile deployment options—Web, desktop, Chrome extension, and Docker—with a pure frontend architecture that ensures data security by processing everything client-side. Perfect for scenarios like roleplay simulation, knowledge graph extraction, and creative writing collaboration.

repos.description: Playwright MCP server
repos.summary_zh: Playwright MCP是微软推出的Model Context Protocol服务器，通过Playwright可访问性树为LLM提供浏览器自动化能力。它摒弃截图方案，采用结构化快照实现确定性操作，适用于探索性测试、自愈脚本和长周期自治工作流。相比CLI工具，MCP模式更适合需要持久状态和深度页面推理的智能体场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwright MCP is a Microsoft Model Context Protocol server that enables LLMs to automate browsers through Playwright's accessibility tree. It replaces screenshot-based approaches with structured snapshots for deterministic, vision-free interactions. Designed for exploratory automation, self-healing tests, and persistent autonomous workflows, it maintains continuous browser context at the cost of higher token usage. The server integrates seamlessly with MCP-compatible clients including VS Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Windsurf, providing a lightweight yet powerful bridge between language models and web automation with rich introspection capabilities.

repos.description: The Open-Source Multimodal AI Agent Stack: Connecting Cutting-Edge AI Models and Agent Infra
repos.summary_zh: UI-TARS-desktop是字节跳动开源的多模态AI智能体桌面应用，基于UI-TARS视觉模型实现GUI自动化操作。支持本地与远程计算机及浏览器控制，无缝集成MCP工具链，通过自然语言指令完成跨应用任务。提供CLI与Web UI双模式，具备流式响应、运行时调试和沙箱隔离等企业级特性，为生产力自动化提供端到端解决方案。
repos.summary_en: UI-TARS-desktop is ByteDance's open-source multimodal AI agent desktop application powered by the UI-TARS vision model for GUI automation. It enables local and remote control of computers and browsers through natural language commands, seamlessly integrating with MCP tools for human-like task completion. Offering both CLI and Web UI interfaces, it features streaming responses, runtime performance statistics, Event Stream Viewer for debugging, and AIO Sandbox isolation. This enterprise-ready stack delivers a complete end-to-end solution for automating productivity workflows across desktop and web environments.

repos.description: "Vibe-Trading: Your Personal Trading Agent"
repos.summary_zh: Vibe-Trading 是港大开源的个人AI交易代理系统，通过单一命令赋予智能体完整交易能力。采用Python 3.11+与FastAPI后端、React 19前端，支持MCP协议实现模型交互。核心亮点包括Swarm集群容错恢复、影子账户模拟交易、Rich交互式CLI。提供API与MCP服务，支持实时任务协调与状态管理，为量化交易提供开箱即用的AI解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vibe-Trading is HKU's open-source personal AI trading agent system that empowers agents with comprehensive trading capabilities through a single command. Built with Python 3.11+ and FastAPI backend, React 19 frontend, it supports MCP for model context interaction. Key features include Swarm cluster fault tolerance recovery, shadow account simulation, Rich interactive CLI, and automated operations. It provides API and MCP services, enabling real-time task coordination and state management for quantitative trading with out-of-the-box AI solutions.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2025 Demo] PDF scientific paper translation with preserved formats - 基于 AI 完整保留排版的 PDF 文档全文双语翻译，支持 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等服务，提供 CLI/GUI/MCP/Docker/Zotero
repos.summary_zh: PDFMathTranslate 是一款专注于科技文献的PDF翻译工具，核心优势在于完整保留原始排版。支持公式、图表、目录、注释等复杂元素的精准定位与翻译。集成Google、DeepL、Ollama、OpenAI等多引擎，提供CLI、GUI、Docker及Zotero插件等多种使用方式。适用于学术研究、论文阅读等场景，支持多语言互译，确保学术文档的专业性与可读性。
repos.summary_en: PDFMathTranslate is a specialized PDF translation tool for scientific documents that preserves original layouts with high fidelity. It accurately handles complex elements including formulas, charts, tables of contents, and annotations. The tool integrates multiple translation backends such as Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI, offering flexible deployment via CLI, GUI, Docker, and Zotero plugins. Designed for academic research and paper reading, it supports multilingual translation while maintaining the professional quality and readability of scholarly documents.

repos.description: Free, local plugin that keeps tool output out of your coding agent's context window. Sandbox and SQLite FTS5 search, 99% fewer bytes in context. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OMP, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and 4 more agents. Zero telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: Context Mode 是面向 AI 编码代理的上下文优化工具。作为 MCP 服务器，它通过沙箱工具输出实现 98% 上下文减少，支持 15 个平台集成。利用 SQLite 追踪会话并以 FTS5/BM25 检索关键信息，倡导代码执行范式处理数据。集成 Claude、Cursor 等 IDE，已获微软、谷歌团队采用。
repos.summary_en: Context Mode optimizes context windows for AI coding agents as an MCP server. It sandboxes tool outputs for 98% reduction, e.g., 315KB to 5.4KB. SQLite with FTS5 and BM25 ensures session continuity by indexing and retrieving relevant events on compaction. 'Think in code' via ctx_* tools lets agents script data processing instead of loading raw data. Supports 15 platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot via plugins and hooks. Adopted by Microsoft, Google, Meta teams.

repos.description: Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
repos.summary_zh: supermemory 是一个高性能、可扩展的AI记忆引擎，定位为用户的'第二大脑'。核心亮点在于支持MCP协议，可无缝集成Claude、Cursor等AI工具，实现智能记忆检索与对话。支持URL、PDF、文本等多格式内容导入，提供浏览器插件和Raycast扩展。采用API优先设计，既可作为个人知识管理平台，也能通过开发者控制台集成到企业工作流，支持自托管部署。
repos.summary_en: Supermemory is a high-performance, scalable AI memory engine positioned as your 'second brain.' Its core strength lies in MCP protocol integration, enabling seamless connectivity with AI tools like Claude and Cursor for intelligent memory retrieval and chat. It supports multi-format content import (URLs, PDFs, text) via browser extensions and Raycast. API-first design allows both personal knowledge management and enterprise workflow integration through its developer console, with self-hosting options available.

repos.description: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
repos.summary_zh: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源平价替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、反向链接、站点审计及 AI 可见性等核心 SEO 工作流。通过 MCP 服务器和可复用技能实现与 Claude 等 AI 智能体的深度集成，支持 Docker 或 Cloudflare 自托管，用户自带 DataForSEO API 密钥实现按需付费。界面简洁现代，聚焦高效工作流，适合个人、团队及 AI 驱动的 SEO 策略定制与控制。
repos.summary_en: OpenSEO is an open-source, pay-as-you-go alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, delivering essential SEO workflows including keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlinks, site audits, and AI visibility. It features deep AI agent integration via MCP server and customizable skills for tools like Claude, with self-hosting options (Docker or Cloudflare) and BYO DataForSEO API key for usage-based costs. The modern, focused UI empowers individuals, teams, and AI-powered SEO strategies with full control and customization.

repos.description: Open-source 3D architecture software for AECO, scan-to-BIM. Agent-friendly, browser-first, MCP, CLI.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Web 的 3D 建筑编辑器，提供浏览器内专业级 BIM 编辑能力。采用 React Three Fiber + WebGPU 实现高性能渲染，Turborepo  monorepo 架构分离核心逻辑与渲染层，Zustand 分层状态管理配合 IndexedDB 持久化与 Zundo 撤销重做，支持建筑模型的节点化数据管理与实时空间查询。
repos.summary_en: A web-based 3D building editor delivering professional BIM capabilities in-browser. Built on React Three Fiber + WebGPU for high-performance rendering, Turborepo monorepo architecture separates core logic from rendering, with layered Zustand state management, IndexedDB persistence, and Zundo undo/redo. Enables node-based building data management and real-time spatial queries.

repos.description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
repos.summary_zh: RooCode是VS Code扩展，提供多模式AI开发团队。支持代码生成、架构设计、调试、文档编写等全流程任务，集成MCP服务器实现工具扩展，通过自然语言指令驱动AI代理完成编程工作。
repos.summary_en: RooCode is a VS Code extension that embeds a complete AI-powered development team directly in your code editor. It provides specialized modes including Code for everyday tasks, Architect for system design, Ask for explanations, Debug for issue tracing, and customizable modes for team workflows. The extension integrates with MCP servers for extensible tooling and enables natural language-driven code generation, refactoring, debugging, documentation writing, and task automation.

repos.description: The all-in-one, open-source backend platform for agentic coding. InsForge gives your coding agent database, auth, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway to ship full-stack apps end-to-end.
repos.summary_zh: InsForge 是专为 AI 编程代理打造的**开源一体化后端平台**，提供数据库、认证、存储、计算、托管及 AI 网关等全栈能力。通过 **MCP Server** 和 **CLI+Skills** 双模式，让 AI 代理能像资深后端工程师一样操作资源，实现应用开发、部署、调试的端到端自动化，极大提升 AI 编程效率与质量。
repos.summary_en: InsForge is an **open-source, all-in-one backend platform** purpose-built for agentic coding. It equips AI coding agents with comprehensive capabilities including database, authentication, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway. Through dual interfaces of **MCP Server** (self-hosted/cloud) and **CLI+Skills** (cloud-only), agents can operate backend resources like professional engineers, enabling **end-to-end automation** of full-stack application development, deployment, and debugging, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and quality.

repos.description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
repos.summary_zh: NoteGen是一款轻量级(25MB)跨平台Markdown笔记应用，深度融合AI智能能力，原生支持RAG检索增强与MCP协议，能够智能桥接碎片化记录与结构化写作，实现知识高效组织与管理。
repos.summary_en: Lightweight (25MB) cross-platform Markdown note app with AI, RAG and MCP support for intelligent knowledge organization.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server是一款基于Chrome扩展的Model Context Protocol服务器，让AI助手直接控制用户现有浏览器。核心优势在于复用日常Chrome环境的登录状态与配置，实现隐私优先的本地自动化。提供20+工具支持截图、网络监控、书签管理等，内置SIMD加速的向量数据库实现智能语义搜索，跨标签页上下文感知，适用于复杂浏览器自动化与内容分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol server that transforms your existing Chrome browser into an AI-controlled automation tool. Unlike Playwright-based solutions, it directly leverages your daily browser with preserved login states and configurations, ensuring privacy through local execution. It offers 20+ tools for screenshots, network monitoring, bookmark management, and more, plus SIMD-accelerated vector search for semantic content discovery. Cross-tab context awareness enables complex browser automation and intelligent content analysis for any LLM or chatbot client.

repos.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个为AI编程代理设计的标准化技能库，通过MCP协议与Stitch设计工具深度集成。提供设计系统文档生成、提示词优化、设计稿转React组件等核心能力，兼容Claude Code、Cursor等主流AI编程工具。采用统一技能结构（SKILL.md + 脚本 + 资源 + 示例），实现从设计到代码的自动化工作流，显著提升AI编程效率与质量。
repos.summary_en: A standardized Agent Skills library for AI coding assistants, deeply integrated with Stitch design tool via MCP protocol. Provides core capabilities including design system documentation generation, prompt enhancement, and design-to-React conversion. Compatible with mainstream AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor. Features unified skill structure (SKILL.md + scripts + resources + examples) to automate design-to-code workflows and boost AI programming efficiency.

repos.description: Agent skill that turns natural language, code, Terraform/K8s, SQL, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protobuf and GraphQL sources into editable, tested draw.io architecture diagrams: incremental sync, multi-view projection, drift diff, CI architecture tests, whiteboard derasterize, interactive HTML/PPTX/Mermaid exports.
repos.summary_zh: drawio-skill 是一款 AI 驱动的技能，将自然语言描述转化为专业的 draw.io 图表。它支持 6 种预设类型（ERD、UML、序列、架构、ML/深度学习、流程图）、代码库（Python/JS/Go/Rust）结构可视化、10,000+ 官方形状搜索及 321 个 AI/LLM 品牌 logo。集成视觉自检与最多 5 轮迭代精炼，自动修复布局问题，支持 PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG 导出。与 Claude、Cursor 等多种 AI 代理兼容，适用于软件架构设计、代码可视化及系统文档生成场景。
repos.summary_en: drawio-skill is an AI agent skill that converts natural language into professional draw.io diagrams. It offers 6 presets (ERD, UML, Sequence, Architecture, ML/Deep Learning, Flowchart), codebase visualization for Python/JS/Go/Rust via Graphviz auto-layout, search across 10,000+ official shapes, and 321 AI/LLM logos. Features vision self-check with up to 5 rounds of refinement, auto-fixes layout issues, and exports to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor and other agents, ideal for architecture design, code analysis, and LLM app documentation.

repos.description: The system of action for AI-native cybersecurity—where intent becomes governed execution, evidence becomes operational memory, and every operation improves the next.
repos.summary_zh: CyberStrikeAI是基于Go构建的AI原生网络安全平台，融合Eino多智能体编排（Deep/Plan-Execute/Supervisor）、MCP原生工具、RAG知识库与攻击链建模。它将自然语言意图转化为受治理的可审计安全行动，支持人机协同、资产/漏洞管理及授权渗透测试，适用于红队与安全运营场景。
repos.summary_en: CyberStrikeAI is a Go-based AI-native cybersecurity platform that turns natural-language intent into governed, auditable security actions. It combines Eino multi-agent orchestration (Deep, Plan-Execute, Supervisor), MCP-native tools, RAG knowledge, visual workflows and attack-chain analysis for authorized penetration testing and security operations.

repos.description: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
repos.summary_zh: HA-MCP 是基于 Model Context Protocol 的智能家居 AI 网关，通过 FastMCP 提供 87 个工具，让 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 助手以自然语言配置和自动化控制 Home Assistant。支持 HACS 安装，兼容所有 Home Assistant 部署类型，实现全功能对等的进程内运行。
repos.summary_en: HA-MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that bridges AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT with Home Assistant. Built with FastMCP, it exposes 87 tools for natural language configuration and automation of smart home devices. Installs via HACS or the built-in Marketplace, runs in-process, and supports all Home Assistant deployment types.

repos.description: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.
repos.summary_zh: 全球首个开源AI原生矢量设计工具，首创并发Agent Teams协同架构，支持多模型智能调度与MCP服务。通过自然语言提示实时流式生成UI，提供Design-as-Code的JSON格式，实现跨平台AI驱动的设计到代码全流程。
repos.summary_en: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent Agent Teams for parallel UI generation. Transforms natural language prompts into live canvas designs with streaming animation, offering Design-as-Code JSON format and MCP server integration for cross-platform AI-driven design-to-code workflows.

repos.description: Open-source auth gateway connecting 1700+ SaaS providers to AI agents through SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP, and OpenAPI.
repos.summary_zh: OpenConnector 是开源 AI 智能体连接网关，替代 Pipedream/Composio。一次授权连接 1500+ SaaS（GitHub、Gmail、Notion 等），通过 SDK、CLI、MCP、HTTP/OpenAPI 暴露 10000+ 预置 Actions。支持凭证管理、可检查 Action 契约、策略控制与运行日志，可自托管（Docker/Node/K8s）或使用 OOMOL 托管运行时。
repos.summary_en: OpenConnector is an open-source auth gateway for AI agents, an alternative to Pipedream/Composio. Connect 1500+ SaaS providers once and expose 10,000+ prebuilt Actions via SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP and OpenAPI. It handles credentials, inspectable contracts, policies and logs, supporting self-hosting (Docker/Node/K8s) or OOMOL-hosted runtime.

repos.description: Exa MCP for web search and web crawling!
repos.summary_zh: Exa MCP Server 是 Exa Labs 推出的 Model Context Protocol 服务，为 AI 助手提供强大的网页搜索、代码检索和企业研究能力。该服务通过标准化接口将 Exa 的智能搜索技术无缝集成到 Cursor、VS Code、Claude 等主流开发环境，支持多种部署方式。开发者只需获取 API 密钥即可让 AI 具备实时网络信息获取和深度内容抓取能力，显著增强智能编程助手的上下文理解和数据检索功能。
repos.summary_en: The Exa MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol service by Exa Labs that equips AI assistants with advanced web search, code retrieval, and company research capabilities. It seamlessly integrates Exa's intelligent search technology into popular development environments like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude through standardized interfaces. Developers can easily connect via API key to enable AI assistants with real-time web information access and deep content crawling, dramatically enhancing context awareness and data retrieval for intelligent coding assistants.

repos.description: Use any LLMs (Large Language Models) for Deep Research. Support SSE API and MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Deep Research是一个隐私优先的深度研究工具，支持Gemini、OpenAI、Deepseek等主流大模型，可在2分钟内生成综合性研究报告。核心亮点包括：浏览器端本地数据处理确保隐私安全；支持Searxng、Tavily等搜索引擎；提供知识图谱构建和本地知识库管理；支持MCP服务器和SSE API。基于Next.js构建，可一键部署至Vercel或Cloudflare，适用于快速调研和知识整理场景。
repos.summary_en: Deep Research is a privacy-first deep research tool that leverages multiple LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Deepseek, etc.) to generate comprehensive reports in approximately 2 minutes. Key features include local browser-side data processing for privacy, integration with search engines like Searxng and Tavily, knowledge graph generation, and local knowledge base management. Built with Next.js, it supports MCP server and SSE API, offering one-click deployment to Vercel or Cloudflare. Ideal for rapid research and knowledge organization with full data control.

repos.description: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration
repos.summary_zh: Anything Analyzer是一款全能协议分析工具，集成内嵌浏览器抓包、MITM代理、JS Hook与AI大模型，支持网页、桌面应用、终端脚本及手机App的全场景流量捕获，所有请求统一汇入Session。AI实现两阶段智能分析、API逆向、安全审计、加密代码提取与流式报告，内置MCP Server/Client无缝对接AI Agent和IDE。基于Electron+React+TypeScript的跨平台桌面应用，显著提升协议逆向与调试效率。
repos.summary_en: Anything Analyzer is an all-in-one protocol analysis toolkit combining embedded browser capture (CDP), MITM proxy, JS hooks for fingerprint spoofing and encryption interception, and AI-powered analysis. It unifies traffic from websites, desktop apps, terminals, scripts, and mobile apps into sessions for automated API reverse engineering, security audits, JS encryption reversal, and more. Built-in MCP server/client enables seamless integration with AI agents and IDEs like Claude and Cursor. Developed with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it provides a cross-platform desktop solution to streamline protocol analysis and debugging.

repos.description: Stealth browser automation for AI agents over MCP and the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigation, network hooks, DOM extraction, and pixel-accurate UI cloning.
repos.summary_zh: Stealth Browser MCP 是专为 MCP 兼容 AI 智能体打造的不可检测浏览器自动化框架。基于 nodriver 与 Chrome DevTools Protocol，能有效绕过 Cloudflare、Queue-It 等反爬系统。核心亮点包括像素完美 UI 元素克隆（提取完整 CSS/DOM/事件）、网络流量拦截与 AI 动态生成 Python 钩子实现实时修改。提供 97 个模块化工具，支持最小化部署与跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker）。无缝集成 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端，通过自然语言聊天执行高级浏览器任务，适用于受保护网站的网页抓取、自动化测试与数据提取。
repos.summary_en: Stealth Browser MCP delivers undetectable browser automation for MCP-compatible AI agents. Powered by nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol, it bypasses Cloudflare, Queue-It, and other anti-bot systems. Highlights include pixel-accurate UI cloning with full CSS/DOM extraction, comprehensive network interception, and an AI-driven dynamic hook system for real-time traffic modification via generated Python functions. It features 97 modular tools with minimal/core modes, cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker), and seamless integration with Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients. Enables natural language control for stealth web scraping, automated testing, and interactions on protected sites.

repos.description: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's full functionality over HTTP. Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant and control x64dbg programmatically: set breakpoints, step through code, read memory, dump registers, and more.  Built with Zig — zero dependencies, single-binary output, cros
repos.summary_zh: x64dbg-MCP Server 是用 Zig 编写的原生 MCP 插件，为零依赖单文件，支持 x32/x64。它通过 HTTP/SSE 暴露 x64dbg 全部调试功能（断点、单步、内存读写、寄存器、反汇编、符号、PE分析等84个工具），让任何兼容 MCP 的 AI 助手可程序化控制调试器，实现智能体驱动的逆向工程。
repos.summary_en: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native Zig-built MCP plugin for x64dbg with zero dependencies and single-binary output for both x32/x64. It exposes full debugger capabilities (84 tools: breakpoints, stepping, memory, registers, disassembly, PE analysis, etc.) over HTTP/SSE, enabling any MCP-compatible AI assistant to programmatically control the debugger for agentic reverse engineering.

repos.description: News Aggregation · AI Ratings · Trading Signals · Real-time Updates
repos.summary_zh: OpenNews MCP 是面向 AI 助手的实时新闻与市场数据聚合服务，整合 85+ 源（新闻、上币、链上、Meme、市场、预测六类），提供 AI 影响力评分、多空交易信号及中英摘要，支持关键词/币种/源过滤与 WebSocket 实时推送，助力加密交易决策。
repos.summary_en: OpenNews MCP is a real-time news and market data aggregation server for AI assistants, covering 85+ sources across six categories (news, listings, on-chain, meme, market, prediction). It delivers AI impact scores, long/short trading signals, bilingual summaries, advanced filters, and WebSocket live updates for crypto trading insights.

repos.description: Fast, native Rust + GPUI workspace for local and SSH with MCP tools—no WebView, no telemetry, open source.
repos.summary_zh: OxideTerm 是一款基于 Tauri 2 和纯 Rust SSH 实现的一体化终端工作台，将本地 Shell、SSH、SFTP、远程 IDE 和 AI 代理集成于单一原生二进制文件中。其核心技术亮点包括智能重连、连接复用、MCP 协议与 RAG 知识库的 AI 集成，以及无 Electron、无 OpenSSL 的轻量化架构，为开发者和运维人员提供高效、稳定的跨平台远程开发体验。
repos.summary_en: OxideTerm is an all-in-one terminal workspace built with Tauri 2 and pure Rust SSH, integrating local shells, SSH, SFTP, remote IDE, and AI agent into a single native binary. Key technical highlights include smart reconnection, connection multiplexing, MCP protocol with RAG-based AI integration, and a lightweight architecture without Electron or OpenSSL, delivering efficient and stable cross-platform remote development experience for developers and operations teams.

repos.description: Integrate Grok's powerful real-time search capabilities into Claude via the MCP protocol!
repos.summary_zh: 通过 MCP 协议将 Grok 实时搜索能力集成至 Claude，突破模型知识截止限制。基于 FastMCP 构建，提供 AI 优化的结构化搜索结果，支持多平台过滤与网页抓取。可一键禁用官方工具并强制路由，实现无缝即插即用。适用于事实核查、实时信息检索与研究分析场景，显著增强 AI 的时效性信息获取能力。
repos.summary_en: Integrates Grok's real-time search capabilities into Claude via MCP protocol, effectively breaking through the model's knowledge cutoff limitation. Built on FastMCP framework, it delivers AI-optimized structured search results with multi-platform filtering and web scraping support. Features one-click disabling of native tools with forced routing for seamless plug-and-play experience. Includes automatic time injection and dynamic model switching capabilities. Ideal for fact-checking, real-time information retrieval, and research analysis scenarios, significantly enhancing AI's ability to access up-to-date information and verify facts with current data.

repos.description: Skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving icons
repos.summary_zh: Better Icons 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的 MCP 服务器和 CLI 工具，支持从 150 多个图标集合中搜索检索 20 万以上图标。它帮助 Cursor、Claude 等 AI 编码代理准确获取图标 SVG，避免 token 浪费和样式不一致，支持多框架导出、项目文件同步、自动学习用户偏好及批量/相似图标检索，有效提升 AI 辅助开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Better Icons is a specialized MCP server and CLI tool for AI agents, enabling search and retrieval of over 200,000 icons from 150+ collections. It assists coding assistants like Cursor and Claude in accurately fetching icons and SVGs, avoiding token waste on inline code. Key capabilities include auto-learning preferences, direct project file syncing, batch retrieval, cross-collection similar icons, and exports for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid plus raw SVG.

repos.description: Secure MCP runtime for AI agents to operate local machines, servers, and containers with multi-device orchestration.
repos.summary_zh: AgentDock 为 AI 智能体提供安全 MCP 运行时，支持多设备编排与跨平台控制。通过统一 MCP 接口实现文件、命令、Git、浏览器自动化等操作，兼容 ChatGPT、Claude 等客户端。支持多实例连接同一对话协调跨设备工作，具备明确权限边界、任务可恢复性和技能扩展能力，适用于开发部署、运维管理和真实环境自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: AgentDock is a secure MCP runtime empowering AI agents with controlled access to local machines, servers, and containers via multi-device orchestration. It unifies file operations, command execution, Git, browser automation, and extensible Skills into an MCP interface compatible with clients like ChatGPT and Claude. Multiple instances connect to one conversation for cross-device coordination, featuring explicit permissions, recoverable tasks, and structured results. Ideal for development, deployment, and operations beyond coding quotas across platforms.

repos.description: 🤖 The largest directory for AI-ready documentation and tools implementing the proposed llms.txt standard
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个 llms.txt 标准的中央资源库，聚合了多种开发者工具与实现方案。通过标准化文档访问协议，指导 AI 模型精准理解项目文档，提升 AI 编程助手准确性与开发者体验。提供 Chrome 插件、VS Code 扩展、MCP 协议支持及 CLI 工具，覆盖主流开发环境，推动 LLM 与文档生态的互操作性。
repos.summary_en: The largest directory for the emerging llms.txt standard, curating production-ready implementations and developer tools across the ecosystem. It establishes a standardized protocol for how LLMs should access and interpret project documentation, significantly improving AI coding assistant accuracy and developer productivity. The hub provides Chrome extensions, VS Code plugins, Model Context Protocol integration, Raycast extensions, and CLI tools covering major development environments, fostering seamless interoperability between AI models and documentation ecosystems while setting clear boundaries for AI-content interaction.

repos.description: 一个透明的 Tavily API 反向代理：将多个 Tavily API Key（额度/credits）汇聚在一个 Master Key 之后，并提供内置 Web UI 用于管理 Key、用量与请求日志。
repos.summary_zh: TavilyProxyManager 是一个专为 Tavily API 设计的高可用代理网关，核心解决多 API Key 的额度聚合与智能调度问题。通过 Master Key 统一鉴权，实现基于剩余额度的动态负载均衡与自动故障切换，有效规避频率限制。内置 Vue3 管理面板提供 Key 管理、用量监控与请求日志分析，同时集成 MCP 协议端点，无缝对接 Claude 等 AI 工具。Go 语言构建，单二进制部署，Docker 开箱即用。
repos.summary_en: TavilyProxyManager is a high-availability proxy gateway designed for Tavily API, solving multi-key quota aggregation and intelligent scheduling. It unifies authentication via Master Key, implements dynamic load balancing based on remaining credits with automatic failover to avoid rate limits. The built-in Vue3 dashboard provides key management, usage monitoring, and request log analysis, while integrated MCP protocol endpoints seamlessly connect with AI tools like Claude. Built with Go, it offers single-binary deployment and Docker-ready out-of-the-box.

repos.description: Paperclip — search, read, and analyze 8M+ biomedical papers from the command line
repos.summary_zh: Paperclip 是一款命令行工具，专为高效检索与分析 800 万+生物医学文献而设计。支持自然语言/正则搜索、并行 AI 阅读、SQL 查询及图表视觉分析，无缝集成 Unix 工具链。可作为 MCP 服务器赋能 AI 智能体，快速完成文献综述、监管文档查询等科研任务。
repos.summary_en: Paperclip is a command-line tool for rapid search and analysis of over 8 million biomedical papers. It enables natural language/regex search, parallel AI reading, SQL queries, and vision-based figure analysis, integrating seamlessly with Unix tools. As an MCP server, it empowers AI agents to efficiently conduct literature reviews and regulatory document queries.
